description: Governor's Office - North Central Province - Mr. P. G. P. K. Abeysooriya of Walikanda Pradeshiya Sabha is removed from the post of Chairman
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the removal of a local government official (Chairman of a Pradeshiya Sabha) following a judicial inquiry into alleged offenses. The content involves law enforcement and judicial processes, specifically the exercise of powers under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act by the Provincial Governor based on a report from a retired High Court Judge. This falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters (Type 9) as it deals with legal proceedings, official disciplinary action, and the enforcement of laws against a public official.
